statement: Sharp legal one-wall budget theorem with actual witness. At resulting rank m let t=q-(5m-16). If the inherited B-side bottom value C(t,2)+B_m lies in 3t+3<=B_m<4t+6, its unique greedy continuation ends in (t+3,2),(R,1), where R=B_m-3t-3=C(B_(m-1),2)-3q-(5m-21). Hence this literal transition has alpha=3, delta=0. Strict ordering beneath the preceding rank-three top t+4 permits bottom shifts s<=3 and rejects s=4, so three is the sharp maximal budget in this one-wall class. The actual K4,r9 odd member j=1231 satisfies the equality-wall interval at the rank 11 to 12 transition; direct uncompressed greedy replay proves both rank-11 words stable, the displayed switched rank-12 word strictly canonical, and gamma_11<0<gamma_12.
